_comment: Hand-authored name data that PyJHora's lang files cannot supply. NEEDS REVIEW by a
Hindi/Sanskrit reader before we treat it as authoritative — everything here was written
by hand, unlike the Hindi full names, which gen-name-locales.js reads straight out of
Two reasons anything lands in this file:
1. `sa` — PyJHora ships no Sanskrit language file at all. These are mostly the Hindi
forms with the spelling a Sanskrit reader expects: cluster consonants rather than
anusvara (कुम्भ not कुंभ), stem forms (धनुस्, चन्द्र), fuller nakshatra names
2. `abbr` — the charts paint 2-letter tags into ~10px SVG cells. Upstream has a
NAKSHATRA_SHORT_LIST but no short forms for rasis or grahas in ANY language, so both
hi and sa are authored here. Grahas take the conventional first akshara. Rasis need
TWO aksharas to stay unambiguous — मेष/मीन and वृषभ/वृश्चिक collide at one.
Order is load-bearing: every array MUST be in canonical order, matching the backend's
tables 1:1 by index (astrology/engine.py ZODIAC_NAMES / NAKSHATRA_NAMES / PLANET_NAMES).
The generator validates lengths but CANNOT catch a wrong name sitting in a right slot.
